alternative_metric: full-record MAE; compare actual legacy examples and declared deterministic loss-ranking cases
amplitude_units: original NPY units; no gain fitting, alignment, trimming or per-record rescaling
mean_square_divisor: L, retaining error bias; not sample variance
secondary_metrics: reconstruction reference/error power ratio in dB
dB_convention: -10log10(mean record NMSE); retain individual-record dB separately, not averaged as a substitute
zero_error: NMSE=0 and reconstruction error ratio=+infinity without an epsilon floor
undefined_correlation: NaN when either centred input has zero power; never replace by a good correlation score
semantic_case_status: deterministic mathematical examples only, not Gaussian/BSC data or validation records
legacy_evidence_scope: 5 complete waveforms; shared prechannel counted once; real examples do not estimate population means or four-configuration R4 effects
